prompt: If I randomly select i.i.d. samples from a distribution n times, the distribution of the sampled variables will approximately follow a normal distribution as n becomes very large. This statement is based on which theory?
answer:
This statement is based on the **Central Limit Theorem (CLT)**.

More precisely, the CLT says that if you take sufficiently large **i.i.d. samples** with finite mean and variance, the distribution of their **sample mean** (or appropriately standardized sum) approaches a normal distribution as the sample size \(n\) increases.

It is the **sample means**, not the individual sampled variables themselves, that become approximately normally distributed.
